verdicts.reason: A is just the square shrunk into the banner: the attribution and the SOLSTICE logo wordmark are too small to read, the jar is tiny, and there is a lot of dead space, so it fails both readability and fit to format. B actually rearranges the layout: the quote is larger with the quote mark beside it, the attribution and logo can be read, and the jar sits in its circle. But the quote is jammed against the top edge, the attribution runs onto the edge of the maroon circle, and the logo floats loosely mid-left instead of sitting on a clear grid.
